title: Thirsty for Mors
description: Thirsty for Mors — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Grasshopper the Decembrist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Retrieve a Mors drink from Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell and then return it to Grasshopper the Decembrist in The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section off the 7th level of Ratsputin's Gulag.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Grasshopper the Decembrist

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Retrieve a Mors drink from Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell and then return it to Grasshopper the Decembrist in The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section off the 7th level of Ratsputin's Gulag.

Offer:

You walk with the grace of a pregnant yak!

The man who says nothing about the rat who is covering the area like a dark cloud over a wake will soon find himself without a voice at his own wake. Ponder this!

While you wander in the circumference of your mind, perform this lesson. Seek out the creator of Mors and bring his or her fine drink to the Grasshopper in The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section.

Turn-in:

In striving to do good for others, you should do so without the expectation of a reward. Yet trust that your good deeds will be rewarded, but don't always expect them to be remembered. That is what it means to work for the greater good. Here is your reward.

Objectives:

  • Mors Drink ×1

Client level range: 75–95
